summary: Himalaya Shipping Ltd., a Bermuda-incorporated bulk carrier, filed a Form 6-K on August 27, 2026, announcing the conversion of index-linked time charters for two vessels to fixed-rate time charters at approximately US$53,000 per day gross, effective September 1, 2026 through March 31, 2027. The filing is a routine operational update, not a special situation. No terms regarding price per share, premium, or deal structure apply. The announcement contains forward-looking statements and is signed by CEO Lars-Christian Svensen. No investor action, board recommendation, or strategic event is indicated; this is purely a charter contract modification.
